items.title: In a locally connected space the open subsets are locally connected and the connected components are open
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file topology.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
items.difficulty_reason: The counted statement is the behaviour of local connectedness and of connected components in a locally connected space (author lemma at source lines 1036-1046, label lemma-locally-connected): opens are locally connected, components are open, and every point has a fundamental system of open connected neighbourhoods. The proof (source lines 1048-1063) works with the fundamental system of connected neighbourhoods of a point: restricting it to an open subset gives (1), and exhibiting a connected neighbourhood inside the component shows the component is a neighbourhood of each of its points, hence open (proof lines 1058-1061). The statement is the local counterpart of the connectedness lemma earlier in the section. H2.
